reason: I want to follow what the kidney filter lets through before tracing what gets recovered.

effect: The urinary organs are connected to the body's circulation, and both chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The final picture made the blood supply and urine route easy to follow.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following filtered fluid into the recovery tube was most worthwhile because it showed that the kidney takes useful substances and water back into the blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ureters and bladder was straightforward but less interesting than seeing what filtering and recovery do.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the filter lets useful glucose and water through along with wastes, rather than picking out only waste.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained why the parts connected.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because following a substance through filtering, recovery and the route out helped me understand how the organs work together.
